summary.text: Jesse Arreguín was elected to represent California's 7th Senate District in November 2024. His official biography says he has twenty years of local and regional government experience as a Berkeley city councilmember, mayor of Berkeley and president of the Association of Bay Area Governments.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Fresno and grew up in San Francisco. According to his official biography, he earned his degree at UC Berkeley and served the Berkeley community on the Rent Stabilization Board, on the City Council and as the first Latino elected mayor of Berkeley.
Arreguín chairs the Senate Committee on Housing and the Committee on Public Safety and lives in Oakland.
